title: Nanotrap® KingFisher™ Concentration/Extraction & MagMAX KingFisher™ Extraction
author: Orlando Sablon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2nkqdcw
materials: KingFisher™ 24 Well Deep Well sample plates
Bovine Respiratory Syncytial Virus (BRSV) INFORCE 3 Intranasa
Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles (10) Ceres Nano Catalog #4420

steps.title: Prepare Sample Plates
steps.instruction: Label two KingFisher™ 24 Well Deep Well sample plates (95040470) as “Sample Plate 1” and “Sample Plate 2”.

steps.title: Add Positive Control and Samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot the following into the designated wells of the sample plates:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of Bovine Respiratory Syncytial Virus (BRSV) INFORCE 3 Intranasal Bovine Vaccine (Zoetis #INF-00089) to every wastewater sample well in Sample Plate 1 only.
Aliquot 4865 µL of wastewater sample into one well (e.g., A1) of Sample Plate 1.
Aliquot 4865 µL of the same wastewater sample into the corresponding well (e.g., A1) of Sample Plate 2.

steps.title: Prepare Negative Controls
steps.instruction: Designate a negative control well on both Sample Plate 1 and Sample Plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Add 4865 µL of Molecular Biology Grade Water (Corning #46-000-CM) into the designated negative control wells on both plates.
Ensure no BRSV or wastewater is added to these wells.

steps.title: Add Enhancement Reagent and Incubate
steps.instruction: Treat all wastewater and negative control wells in both sample plates with enhancement reagent.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of Enhancement Reagent 1 (Ceres Nano #10111-10) to each well.
Incubate the plates for 10 minutes at 20 °C (room temperature).

steps.title: Add Nanotrap Magnetic Particles
steps.instruction: Add magnetic particles to the sample plates after thorough mixing.

substeps.instruction: Vortex and thoroughly mix the Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles (10) (Ceres Nano #44202).
Aliquot 75 µL of the particles to each wastewater sample well and negative control well in both plates.

steps.title: Prepare Nanotrap Extraction Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary plates for the KingFisher™ automated run.

substeps.instruction: Insert the KingFisher™ 24 well-KF Deep Well Comb (97002610) into Sample Plate 1.
Prepare Wash 1 Plate: Aliquot 1 mL of MagMAX Wash Buffer (from Kit A42352) into a new KingFisher™ 96 Deep Well Plate, matching the number and location of the sample wells.
Prepare Lysis Plate: Aliquot 500 µL of MagMAX™ Microbiome Lysis Solution (Thermo Fisher #A42361) into a third KingFisher™ 24 Deep-Well Plate, matching the number and location of the sample wells.

steps.title: Run Nanotrap KingFisher Script
steps.instruction: Execute the automated Nanotrap script on the KingFisher™ system.

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher™ Flex System: run KF-008-WW-Nanotrap-24.bdz.
For KingFisher™ Apex System: run KF-003-WW-Nanotrap-24.kfx.
Follow on-screen instructions to load plates at the appropriate times.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a new KingFisher™ 96 Deep Well Plate for bead binding.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 10 µL of MagMAX Proteinase K to each well intended for lysate.
Aliquot 400 µL of lysate from each well of the Lysis Plate (from the previous step) into the Binding Plate (discard remaining ~100 µL in the lysis plate).
Aliquot 530 µL of MagMAX Binding Solution into each well containing lysate.

steps.title: Add Binding Beads
steps.instruction: Add binding beads to the Binding Plate to reach the final volume.

substeps.instruction: Vortex and thoroughly mix the MagMAX DNA/RNA Binding Beads.
Aliquot 20 µL of vortexed binding beads to each well containing lysate (total final volume should be 960 µL; do not exceed 1000 µL to avoid contamination).

steps.title: Prepare MagMAX Extraction Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the remaining plates for the MagMAX extraction procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Wash Plate 2: Aliquot 1 mL of 80% EtOH into a new KingFisher™ 96 Deep Well Plate, matching the sample well locations.
Prepare Elution Plate: Aliquot 60 µL of MagMAX Elution buffer into a new KingFisher™ 96 - 200 µL plate, matching the sample well locations.
Insert the KingFisher™ 96 Deep Well Comb into the Binding Plate.

steps.title: Run MagMAX KingFisher Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the automated MagMAX extraction script on the KingFisher™ system.

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher™ Flex System: run KF-008-WW-MagMAX-96.bdz.
For KingFisher™ Apex System: run KF-003-WW-MagMAX-96.kfx.
Follow on-screen instructions to load the Binding, Wash 1, Wash 2, and Elution plates at the appropriate times.

steps.title: Collect Purified RNA
steps.instruction: Retrieve the purified viral RNA from the KingFisher™ 96-Elution Plate (~60 µL per well) and load into a PCR plate or 1.7 mL RNA tube.
